title: Representing alternating groups as self-dual string C-groups of high rank
summary: The highest rank of a string C-group representation of the alternating group $A_n$ is known for each $n$, but no self-dual representations attaining this highest rank are known when $n > 12$. Motivated by computational results for alternating groups of small degree, we examine a vertex-gluing construction for permutation representation graphs. We establish conditions under which gluing two string C-groups produces another string C-group, and use this construction to obtain infinite families of self-dual representations of alternating groups.
